title: Biased query score
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in\mathbb{R}$, let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The biased query score is the sum, over the coordinates queried by $T$ on input $x$, of the biased standardized sign associated with bias $p$ and the sign $x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: the tree has an available-coordinate set
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition or domain restrictions of the biased standardized sign, so its exact mathematical meaning cannot be stated more precisely.
